newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was quiet late Tuesday. There were no sales of slaughter steers or heifers confirmed at the close.

Inquiry was moderate, demand was light. Sales confirmed for the week to date on 11,200 head, mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle. Wednesday bids 66.00, asking 68.00-69.00. Last established prices 67.00 Friday, March 28.
